__comment_format: JSON does not support native comments. Use __comment_* keys for inline guidance.
__comment_git_routing: Recommended: keep git_write_target=bot for protected repositories. Use main only when direct pushes are allowed.
__comment_feature_flags: Set false to disable job behavior without editing workflows.
__comment_housekeeping_windows: Hours since draft creation when reminders and expiry should trigger.
__comment_token_thresholds: Days since token timestamps when reminders should trigger.
